short.id: Alur kerja dasar: proyek → geometri → aliran → plan → jalankan → hasil.
short.en: Basic workflow: project → geometry → flow → plan → run → results.

body.id:
Fungsi

De-RAS menghitung muka air sungai 1D steady (rezim subkritis, superkritis, atau campuran) dan memakai file proyek HEC-RAS (.prj, .g##, .f##, .p##) sebagai format aslinya. Proyek yang disimpan De-RAS tetap bisa dibuka di HEC-RAS, dan sebaliknya untuk fitur yang didukung.

Langkah

  1. Di Beranda (tombol rumah atau Ctrl+1), buat proyek baru (Ctrl+N), buka file .prj (Ctrl+O), atau buka proyek contoh.
  2. Buka Data Geometri (Ctrl+2); klik ganda penampang untuk membuka Editor Penampang.
  3. Isi debit dan kondisi batas hilir di Aliran Steady (Ctrl+3).
  4. Periksa plan di Analisis Steady (Ctrl+5), lalu tekan F7 (Model Doctor) dan F5 (Hitung).
  5. Jendela Komputasi menampilkan kemajuan; setelah selesai klik Lihat hasil.
  6. Di Hasil, lihat penampang, profil memanjang dan tabel; ekspor CSV atau laporan HTML.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Penampang melintang (stasiun–elevasi), n Manning, jarak antarpenampang, debit per profil, kondisi batas hilir.

Hasil

Muka air, garis energi, kecepatan, luas, lebar muka air, dan bilangan Froude per penampang. Hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS.

Status: Tersedia
body.en:
Purpose

De-RAS computes 1D steady water surface profiles (subcritical, supercritical or mixed regime) and uses HEC-RAS project files (.prj, .g##, .f##, .p##) as its native format. Projects saved by De-RAS can still be opened in HEC-RAS, and vice versa for supported features.

Steps

  1. On Home, create a new project (Ctrl+N), open a .prj file (Ctrl+O), or open the example project.
  2. Open Geometric Data (Ctrl+2); double-click a cross section to open the Cross Section Editor.
  3. Enter discharges and downstream boundaries in Steady Flow (Ctrl+3).
  4. Check the plan in Steady Analysis (Ctrl+5), then press F7 (Model Doctor) and F5 (Compute).
  5. The Compute window shows progress; when it finishes click View results.
  6. In Results, review cross sections, the longitudinal profile and tables; export CSV or an HTML report.

Data needed

Cross sections (station–elevation), Manning's n, reach lengths, discharge per profile, downstream boundary.

Result

Water surface, energy grade, velocity, area, top width and Froude number per cross section. Equivalence with HEC-RAS has not been validated.

Status: Available

short.id: Membuat proyek HEC-RAS baru dari satu lembar isian (Ctrl+N).
short.en: Creates a new HEC-RAS project from a single form (Ctrl+N).

body.id:
Fungsi

Membuat file .prj, .g01, .f01 dan .p01 di folder pilihan Anda.

Langkah

  1. Klik Proyek baru di Beranda atau Berkas → Proyek baru.
  2. Bagian 1: isi judul, nama file dan folder.
  3. Bagian 2: pilih satuan, sistem koordinat dan zona waktu.
  4. Bagian 3: isi nama sungai dan reach, lalu pilih template kosong atau saluran prismatik.
  5. Klik Buat proyek.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Nama file tanpa spasi; folder yang bisa ditulisi.

Hasil

Proyek baru langsung terbuka: template prismatik di Beranda, template kosong di Data Geometri. De-RAS tidak pernah menimpa proyek yang sudah ada.

Status: Tersedia
body.en:
Purpose

Creates .prj, .g01, .f01 and .p01 files in the folder you choose.

Steps

  1. Click New project on Home or File → New project.
  2. Section 1: enter a title, file name and folder.
  3. Section 2: choose units, coordinate system and time zone.
  4. Section 3: enter river and reach names, then choose an empty or prismatic-channel template.
  5. Click Create project.

Data needed

A file name without spaces; a writable folder.

Result

The new project opens right away: the prismatic template on Home, the empty template in Geometric Data. De-RAS never overwrites an existing project.

Status: Available

  2. Pilih file .prj.
  3. Periksa panel Pesan untuk peringatan pembacaan.

Proyek terbuka; file yang tidak diubah ditulis ulang byte demi byte sama.

  2. Choose the .prj file.
  3. Check the Messages panel for read warnings.

Data needed

The .prj file and the files it references in the same folder.

Result

The project opens; unchanged files are written back byte-for-byte identical.

short.en: Edit reaches and 1D cross sections: station–elevation, Manning's n, lengths, banks and coefficients.

body.id:
Fungsi

Setiap perubahan langsung terlihat di plot dan masuk ke file .g## saat Anda menyimpan (Ctrl+S).

Langkah

  1. Dari Data Geometri, klik ganda penampang di kanvas atau klik Penampang di palet.
  2. Pilih reach dan RS di baris atas; PgUp/PgDn pindah ke penampang sebelum/berikutnya.
  3. Edit tabel stasiun–elevasi; tempel dari Excel dengan Ctrl+V.
  4. Isi jarak ke penampang hilir, tebing, n Manning dan koefisien di kartu Data penampang.
  5. Tambah, salin atau hapus penampang dengan tombol di baris atas; simpan dengan Ctrl+S.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Data survei penampang; nilai n Manning; jarak antarpenampang (kiri, alur, kanan).

Hasil

File .g## yang bisa dibuka HEC-RAS.

Status: Tersedia
body.en:
Purpose

All edits go straight into the .g## model and are saved with Ctrl+S. The cross-section plot updates immediately.

Steps

  1. From Geometric Data, double-click a cross section on the canvas or click Cross section in the palette.
  2. Choose the reach and RS in the top row; PgUp/PgDn move to the previous/next section.
  3. Edit the station–elevation table; paste from Excel with Ctrl+V.
  4. Enter downstream lengths, banks, Manning's n and coefficients in the Section data card.
  5. Add, copy or delete sections with the buttons in the top row; save with Ctrl+S.

Data needed

Cross-section survey data; Manning's n values; reach lengths (left, channel, right).

Result

A .g## file that HEC-RAS can open.

short.id: Jembatan dengan dek, pilar, dan aliran di atas dek.
short.en: A bridge with deck, piers and flow over the deck.

body.id:
Fungsi

Aliran rendah (muka air di bawah dek): metode energi melalui penampang di dalam jembatan dengan pilar sebagai penghalang, dan rumus Yarnell (K = 1,25); hasil dengan energi tertinggi dipakai. Aliran tinggi: rumus sluice gate (Cd dari rasio Y3/Z) atau orifice (C = 0,8) bila sisi hilir dek terendam, ditambah aliran pelimpah di atas dek dengan reduksi terendam Villemonte.

Langkah

  1. Buka Data Geometri, klik Jembatan / Gorong-gorong di palet.
  2. Pilih reach, klik Tambah jembatan.
  3. Isi river station (di antara dua penampang), jarak ke muka hulu, lebar dek, dan koefisien pelimpah.
  4. Isi tabel dek (stasiun, elevasi atas, elevasi bawah) dan pilar.
  5. Klik Tambah, lalu simpan proyek.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Blok Type RM = 3 dengan baris Bridge Culvert-, Deck Dist Width WeirC, dan Pier di file .g##.

Hasil

Status Pratinjau: belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS; format blok di file .g## belum diverifikasi. Hanya rezim subkritis.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Low flow (water below the deck): energy method through sections inside the bridge with piers as obstructions, and the Yarnell equation (K = 1.25); the highest energy answer is used. High flow: sluice gate equation (Cd from Y3/Z) or orifice (C = 0.8) when the downstream low chord is submerged, plus weir flow over the deck with Villemonte submergence.

Steps

  1. Open Geometric Data, click Bridge / Culvert in the palette.
  2. Pick the reach, click Add bridge.
  3. Enter the river station (between two sections), distance to the upstream face, deck width and weir coefficient.
  4. Fill the deck table (station, high chord, low chord) and the piers.
  5. Click Add, then save the project.

Data needed

A Type RM = 3 block with Bridge Culvert-, Deck Dist Width WeirC and Pier lines in the .g## file.

Result

Preview status: not compared with HEC-RAS yet; the block format in the .g## file is not verified. Subcritical regime only.

Status: Preview

short.id: Gorong-gorong lingkaran atau kotak di bawah timbunan jalan.
short.en: Circular or box culverts under a road embankment.

body.id:
Fungsi

Energi hulu adalah yang terbesar dari kontrol inlet (persamaan FHWA HDS-5 bentuk 1, chart 1, 2, 8 dan scale 1–3, dengan transisi tak terendam/terendam antara 3,5 dan 4,0) dan kontrol outlet (kehilangan masuk, gesekan, dan keluar dengan aliran penuh di atas maks(TW, (dc + D)/2)). Aliran di atas jalan dihitung sebagai pelimpah.

Langkah

  1. Klik Jembatan / Gorong-gorong di palet, lalu Tambah gorong-gorong.
  2. Isi tabel jalan (elevasi atas = elevasi bawah untuk timbunan).
  3. Isi satu baris per kelompok barrel identik: bentuk, bentang, tinggi, panjang, n, Ke, Kx, chart, scale, invert, dan stasiun barrel.
  4. Klik Tambah.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Baris Culvert= di blok Type RM = 2 file .g## (satu baris per barrel).

Hasil

Status Pratinjau: belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS; format blok di file .g## belum diverifikasi. Hanya rezim subkritis.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

The upstream energy is the larger of inlet control (FHWA HDS-5 form 1 equations, charts 1, 2, 8 and scales 1–3, with the unsubmerged/submerged transition between 3.5 and 4.0) and outlet control (entrance, friction and exit losses with full flow above max(TW, (dc + D)/2)). Flow over the road is computed as weir flow.

Steps

  1. Click Bridge / Culvert in the palette, then Add culvert.
  2. Fill the road table (high chord = low chord for an embankment).
  3. Enter one row per group of identical barrels: shape, span, rise, length, n, Ke, Kx, chart, scale, inverts and barrel stations.
  4. Click Add.

Data needed

Culvert= lines in a Type RM = 2 block of the .g## file (one line per barrel).

Result

Preview status: not compared with HEC-RAS yet; the block format in the .g## file is not verified. Subcritical regime only.

body.id:
Fungsi

Opsi → Konversi satuan proyek SI ↔ US… (Pratinjau, sejak 0.2.3) membuat salinan proyek di folder yang sama dengan nama baru, lalu mengubah satuan salinan: geometri (stasiun, elevasi, panjang, struktur), aliran steady dan unsteady, toleransi plan, dan data modul De-RAS (bukaan pintu, pompa, breach, sedimen, kualitas air). n Manning, koefisien kontraksi/ekspansi dan konsentrasi tidak berubah. Koefisien pelimpah dikali √0,3048 (atau dibagi). Proyek asli tidak diubah.

Langkah

  1. Simpan proyek.
  2. Buka Opsi dan klik Konversi satuan proyek SI ↔ US….
  3. Terima atau ubah nama salinan.
  4. Pilih Buka salinan, lalu hitung ulang semua plan.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Terrain, gambar dan layer GIS tidak dikonversi; satuan elevasinya tetap seperti semula, jadi peta dan area 2D di salinan memakai terrain yang satuannya berbeda sampai terrain diganti. File hasil tidak ikut disalin. Angka di file HEC-RAS dibulatkan ke lebar kolom 8 karakter.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Options → Convert project units SI ↔ US… (Preview, since 0.2.3) copies the project into the same folder under a new name, then converts the copy: geometry (stations, elevations, lengths, structures), steady and unsteady flow, plan tolerances, and the De-RAS module data (gate openings, pumps, breaches, sediment, water quality). Manning's n, contraction/expansion coefficients and concentrations do not change. Weir coefficients are multiplied (or divided) by √0.3048. The original project is not changed.

Steps

  1. Save the project.
  2. Open Options and click Convert project units SI ↔ US….
  3. Accept or change the name of the copy.
  4. Choose Open the copy, then compute every plan again.

Data needed

Terrains, pictures and GIS layers are not converted; their elevation units stay as they were, so maps and 2D areas of the copy use a terrain in other units until it is replaced. Result files are not copied. Numbers in the HEC-RAS files are rounded to the 8-character column width.

Where terrains overlap, the first one in the list is used.

Steps

  1. Click Add GeoTIFF… on the Terrain card.
  2. Choose the .tif file.
  3. Save the project so the terrain is recorded.

Fungsi

World file berisi enam angka yang menaruh gambar di peta (mis. foto.pgw untuk foto.png, foto.jgw untuk foto.jpg). Gambar yang diputar belum didukung. Gambar tidak disalin; hanya lokasinya yang dicatat.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

A world file holds six numbers that place the picture on the map (e.g. photo.pgw for photo.png, photo.jgw for photo.jpg). Rotated pictures are not supported yet. Pictures are not copied; only their location is recorded.

Status: Preview

short.id: Garis tengah reach (biru, panah ke hilir) dan garis potong penampang (kuning).
short.en: Reach centrelines (blue, arrow pointing downstream) and cross-section cut lines (yellow).

body.id:
Fungsi

Garis potong dari file (XS GIS Cut Line) digambar utuh. Penampang tanpa garis potong digambar putus-putus, tegak lurus garis tengah dan berjarak sesuai panjang ruas alur utama.

Status: Tersedia
body.en:
Purpose

Cut lines from the file (XS GIS Cut Line) are solid. Sections without one are dashed, across the centreline and spaced by the main-channel lengths.

Status: Available

title.en: Cut cross sections from the terrain

short.id: Membuat penampang baru dari garis yang digambar di atas terrain, atau memperbarui penampang terpilih.
short.en: Creates a new cross section from a line drawn on the terrain, or updates the selected one.

body.id:
Fungsi

Titik stasiun-elevasi diambil setiap jarak sampel (bawaan: ukuran sel terrain), lalu titik yang segaris dibuang sampai paling banyak 500 titik. Tebing, n Manning, dan koefisien disalin dari penampang tetangga dan digeser ke titik terdekat. Panjang ruas penampang hulu dibagi dua menurut posisi garis. Garis yang digambar dari kanan ke kiri dibalik otomatis.

Langkah

  1. Klik Potong penampang.
  2. Klik titik-titik garis dari tebing kiri ke kanan (menghadap hilir), memotong garis tengah reach.
  3. Klik ganda atau Enter untuk selesai.
  4. Periksa RS usulan, klik Buat penampang.
  5. Periksa tebing dan n di Editor Penampang, lalu simpan geometri.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Baris XS GIS Cut Line= di file .g##.

Hasil

Status Pratinjau: belum dibandingkan dengan RAS Mapper HEC-RAS.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Station-elevation points are sampled every sample spacing (default: the terrain cell size), then points on a straight line are dropped until at most 500 remain. Bank stations, Manning's n and coefficients are copied from the neighbouring section and moved to the nearest points. The upstream section's reach lengths are split by the position of the line. A line drawn right to left is reversed automatically.

Steps

  1. Click Cut cross section.
  2. Click the line points from the left to the right bank (looking downstream), crossing the reach centreline.
  3. Double-click or press Enter to finish.
  4. Check the proposed RS, click Create section.
  5. Check banks and n in the Cross-Section Editor, then save the geometry.

Data needed

The XS GIS Cut Line= line of the .g## file.

Result

Preview status: not compared with HEC-RAS RAS Mapper yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Kedalaman dan muka air satu profil steady di atas terrain.
short.en: Depth and water surface of one steady profile over the terrain.

body.id:
Fungsi

Di antara dua garis potong yang berurutan, muka air diinterpolasi linear menurut jarak ke kedua garis. Kedalaman = muka air - terrain, hanya yang positif. Grid mengikuti terrain pertama. Belum ada cek keterhubungan aliran, jadi cekungan terpisah di dalam batas garis potong ikut tergenang.

Langkah

  1. Jalankan plan (F5).
  2. Di RAS Mapper pilih profil di kartu Peta genangan.
  3. Klik Hitung peta.

Hasil

Status Pratinjau: belum dibandingkan dengan RAS Mapper HEC-RAS.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Between two consecutive cut lines the water surface is interpolated linearly by the distances to both lines. Depth = water surface - terrain, positive values only. The grid follows the first terrain. There is no flow connectivity check yet, so separate depressions inside the cut lines are flooded too.

Steps

  1. Run the plan (F5).
  2. In RAS Mapper pick a profile on the Inundation map card.
  3. Click Compute map.

Result

Preview status: not compared with HEC-RAS RAS Mapper yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Kedalaman atau muka air sebagai GeoTIFF, atau gambar peta sebagai PNG.
short.en: Depth or water surface as GeoTIFF, or the map picture as PNG.

body.id:
Fungsi

GeoTIFF ditulis float32 tanpa kompresi dengan no data -9999 dan sistem koordinat terrain, sehingga bisa dibuka di QGIS atau ArcGIS.

Status: Tersedia
body.en:
Purpose

GeoTIFFs are float32, uncompressed, no data -9999, with the terrain's coordinate system, so they open in QGIS or ArcGIS.

Status: Available

short.id: Penampang satu reach dan muka air satu profil dalam tampilan tiga dimensi.
short.en: The cross sections of one reach and the water surface of one profile in a three-dimensional view.

body.id:
Fungsi

Penampang diletakkan menurut panjang ruas alur utama, berpusat di tengah alur. Seret untuk memutar, roda mouse untuk mengubah skala vertikal.

Status: Tersedia
body.en:
Purpose

Sections are placed by the main-channel lengths, centred on the channel. Drag to rotate, mouse wheel to change the vertical exaggeration.

Status: Available

short.id: Kondisi batas yang berubah terhadap waktu dan debit awal (file .u##, Ctrl+4).
short.en: Time-varying boundary conditions and initial flows (.u## file, Ctrl+4).

body.id:
Fungsi

Kiri: daftar lokasi kondisi batas. Kanan: data lokasi terpilih (jenis, interval, tabel nilai dan grafik). Di bawah daftar: debit awal per reach.

Langkah

  1. Pilih file aliran unsteady di atas daftar, atau buat baru dengan tombol +.
  2. Klik Lengkapi ujung reach. Ujung hulu mendapat hidrograf debit, ujung hilir normal depth.
  3. Pilih tiap lokasi dan isi datanya.
  4. Isi debit awal setiap reach.
  5. Simpan proyek, lalu buka Analisis Unsteady.

Data yang dibutuhkan

File .u## (Boundary Location, Interval, Flow Hydrograph, Stage Hydrograph, Friction Slope, Initial Flow Loc).

Hasil

Status Pratinjau: hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS. Hanya rezim subkritis, satu alur per reach. Struktur lateral, storage area, area 2D, sambungan, dan pompa dihitung sejak 0.2.3 (juga Pratinjau); jembatan, gorong-gorong, dan struktur inline belum dihitung di unsteady.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Left: the list of boundary locations. Right: the data of the selected location (type, interval, value table and plot). Below the list: initial flows per reach.

Steps

  1. Pick the unsteady flow file above the list, or create one with the + button.
  2. Click Add reach ends. Upstream ends get a flow hydrograph, downstream ends normal depth.
  3. Select each location and enter its data.
  4. Enter the initial flow of every reach.
  5. Save the project, then open Unsteady Analysis.

Data needed

The .u## file (Boundary Location, Interval, Flow Hydrograph, Stage Hydrograph, Friction Slope, Initial Flow Loc lines).

Result

Preview status: results are not compared with HEC-RAS yet. Subcritical only, one flow path per reach. Lateral structures, storage areas, 2D areas, connections and pumps are computed since 0.2.3 (also Preview); bridges, culverts and inline structures are not computed in unsteady runs yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Setiap ujung hulu dan hilir reach yang tidak tersambung ke junction butuh satu kondisi batas.
short.en: Every upstream and downstream reach end not connected to a junction needs one boundary condition.

body.id:
Fungsi

Lengkapi ujung reach menambahkan lokasi yang belum ada. Aliran lateral… menambah debit masuk di tengah reach. Hapus membuang lokasi terpilih. Model Doctor memberi kesalahan bila ada ujung reach tanpa kondisi batas atau dengan jenis yang tidak cocok (mis. normal depth di hulu).

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Add reach ends adds the missing locations. Lateral inflow… adds an inflow inside a reach. Delete removes the selected location. Model Doctor reports an error when a reach end has no boundary condition or an unsuitable type (e.g. normal depth upstream).

Status: Preview

short.id: Debit di setiap reach pada awal simulasi.
short.en: The flow in every reach at the start of the simulation.

body.id:
Fungsi

De-RAS menghitung profil steady (backwater subkritis) dengan debit ini dan kondisi batas hilir pada jam pertama, lalu memakainya sebagai keadaan awal. Kosong berarti nilai pertama hidrograf hulu dipakai.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

De-RAS computes a steady (subcritical backwater) profile with these flows and the downstream boundary at the first hour, and uses it as the initial state. Empty means the first value of the upstream hydrograph is used.

Status: Preview

short.id: Jenis, interval, dan nilai kondisi batas pada lokasi terpilih.
short.en: Type, interval and values of the boundary condition at the selected location.

body.id:
Fungsi

Tabel dan grafik menyesuaikan jenis: hidrograf (nilai per interval), normal depth (kemiringan gesek), atau rating curve (pasangan elevasi–debit).

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

The table and plot follow the type: hydrograph (one value per interval), normal depth (friction slope) or rating curve (stage–flow pairs).

Status: Preview

short.id: Hidrograf debit, hidrograf muka air, aliran lateral, aliran lateral merata, normal depth, dan rating curve.
short.en: Flow hydrograph, stage hydrograph, lateral inflow, uniform lateral inflow, normal depth and rating curve.

body.id:
Fungsi

Hulu: hidrograf debit atau muka air. Hilir: hidrograf muka air, normal depth, rating curve, atau hidrograf debit. Di tengah reach: aliran lateral (satu titik) atau aliran lateral merata (dibagi rata menurut panjang antara dua RS). Jenis lain (mis. gate opening, IB stage/flow) tetap disimpan di file tetapi belum dihitung.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Upstream: flow or stage hydrograph. Downstream: stage hydrograph, normal depth, rating curve or flow hydrograph. Inside a reach: lateral inflow (one point) or uniform lateral inflow (spread by length between two RS). Other types (e.g. gate openings, IB stage/flow) stay in the file but are not computed yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Jarak waktu antara dua nilai data, langkah hitung, atau keluaran: 1MIN sampai 1DAY.
short.en: The time between two data values, computation steps or outputs: 1MIN to 1DAY.

body.id:
Fungsi

Interval data hidrograf tidak harus sama dengan interval komputasi; nilai di antaranya diinterpolasi linear. Interval keluaran sebaiknya kelipatan interval komputasi. Hasil disimpan paling banyak 100 waktu keluaran.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

The hydrograph data interval need not match the computation interval; values in between are interpolated linearly. The output interval should be a multiple of the computation interval. At most 100 output times are stored.

Status: Preview

short.id: Deret nilai debit atau muka air, satu per interval data, mulai dari waktu mulai simulasi.
short.en: A series of flow or stage values, one per data interval, starting at the simulation start time.

body.id:
Fungsi

Ketik atau tempel nilai di tabel; grafik di samping ikut berubah. Kalau simulasi lebih panjang dari hidrograf, nilai terakhir dipakai terus dan Model Doctor memberi peringatan.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Type or paste values into the table; the plot alongside updates. If the simulation is longer than the hydrograph, the last value is held and Model Doctor warns.

Status: Preview

short.id: Debit hilir dari persamaan Manning dengan kemiringan gesek yang diisi.
short.en: The downstream flow from Manning's equation with the given friction slope.

body.id:
Fungsi

Di setiap langkah, debit di ujung hilir dihitung dari muka air saat itu: Q = K·√S. Kemiringan harus lebih dari 0.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

At every step the downstream flow is computed from the current water surface: Q = K·√S. The slope must be greater than 0.

Status: Preview

short.id: Hubungan elevasi–debit di ujung hilir.
short.en: A stage–flow relation at the downstream end.

body.id:
Fungsi

Isi pasangan elevasi dan debit yang naik. Di antara titik dipakai interpolasi linear. Format baris Rating Curve di file .u## belum diverifikasi dengan HEC-RAS.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Enter increasing stage and flow pairs. Linear interpolation is used between points. The Rating Curve line format of the .u## file is not verified against HEC-RAS yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Debit masuk di tengah reach, di satu penampang atau merata di antara dua penampang.
short.en: Inflow inside a reach, at one cross section or spread between two cross sections.

body.id:
Langkah

  1. Klik Aliran lateral….
  2. Pilih reach, jenis, dan RS masuk (dan RS akhir untuk aliran merata).
  3. Klik Tambah, lalu isi hidrografnya.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Steps

  1. Click Lateral inflow….
  2. Pick the reach, the type and the inflow RS (and the end RS for uniform inflow).
  3. Click Add, then fill its hydrograph.

Status: Preview

short.id: Plan unsteady: file geometri dan aliran, waktu simulasi, interval, opsi, dan Model Doctor.
short.en: Unsteady plan: geometry and flow files, simulation window, intervals, options and Model Doctor.

body.id:
Fungsi

Metode: skema implisit Preissmann empat titik pada persamaan Saint-Venant, iterasi Newton per langkah. Keadaan awal dari profil steady. Junction memakai muka air sama dan kontinuitas. Model Doctor menolak run bila geometri berisi jembatan, gorong-gorong, atau struktur inline.

Langkah

  1. Pilih plan unsteady, atau klik + untuk membuat plan baru.
  2. Pilih file geometri dan file aliran unsteady.
  3. Isi tanggal dan jam mulai dan selesai (mis. 01JAN2024, 0000).
  4. Pilih interval komputasi dan keluaran.
  5. Tekan F7 untuk Model Doctor, lalu F5 untuk menghitung.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Baris Simulation Date, Computation Interval, Output Interval, UNET Theta, UNET ZTol, dan UNET MaxIter di file .p##.

Hasil

Hasil ditulis ke <nama>.<plan>.deras-results.json: profil Max WS, profil setiap waktu keluaran, dan time series muka air dan debit di semua penampang. File .hdf hasil unsteady belum ditulis. Status Pratinjau: hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS. Hanya rezim subkritis, satu alur per reach. Struktur lateral, storage area, area 2D, sambungan, dan pompa dihitung sejak 0.2.3 (juga Pratinjau); jembatan, gorong-gorong, dan struktur inline belum dihitung di unsteady.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Method: the four-point Preissmann implicit scheme on the Saint-Venant equations, Newton iterations per step. The initial state comes from a steady profile. Junctions use equal stage and continuity. Model Doctor refuses the run when the geometry contains bridges, culverts or inline structures.

Steps

  1. Pick an unsteady plan, or click + to create one.
  2. Pick the geometry file and the unsteady flow file.
  3. Enter the start and end dates and times (e.g. 01JAN2024, 0000).
  4. Choose the computation and output intervals.
  5. Press F7 for Model Doctor, then F5 to compute.

Data needed

Simulation Date, Computation Interval, Output Interval, UNET Theta, UNET ZTol and UNET MaxIter lines in the .p## file.

Result

Results go to <name>.<plan>.deras-results.json: a Max WS profile, a profile for every output time, and stage and flow time series at every section. No unsteady .hdf results file is written yet. Preview status: results are not compared with HEC-RAS yet. Subcritical only, one flow path per reach. Lateral structures, storage areas, 2D areas, connections and pumps are computed since 0.2.3 (also Preview); bridges, culverts and inline structures are not computed in unsteady runs yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Tanggal dan jam mulai dan selesai simulasi.
short.en: Start and end date and time of the simulation.

body.id:
Fungsi

Tanggal ditulis DDMMMYYYY (mis. 01JAN2024), jam HHMM (mis. 0000 atau 2400). Selesai harus setelah mulai. Hidrograf dimulai pada waktu mulai.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Dates are written DDMMMYYYY (e.g. 01JAN2024), times HHMM (e.g. 0000 or 2400). The end must be after the start. Hydrographs start at the start time.

Status: Preview

short.id: Bobot implisit (0,5–1,0), toleransi muka air, dan iterasi maksimum per langkah.
short.en: Implicit weighting (0.5–1.0), water surface tolerance and maximum iterations per step.

body.id:
Fungsi

Theta 1,0 paling stabil; nilai mendekati 0,6 lebih akurat tetapi bisa berosilasi. Iterasi Newton berhenti bila perubahan muka air di bawah toleransi. Bila iterasi maksimum tercapai, langkah tetap diterima dan dicatat sebagai peringatan.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Theta 1.0 is the most stable; values near 0.6 are more accurate but can oscillate. Newton iterations stop when the water surface change is below the tolerance. When the maximum is reached the step is still accepted and logged as a warning.

Status: Preview

short.id: Muka air dan debit terhadap waktu di satu penampang, dari hasil plan unsteady.
short.en: Stage and flow against time at one cross section, from an unsteady plan result.

body.id:
Fungsi

Pilih reach dan penampang. Grafik atas: muka air dengan garis dasar alur. Grafik bawah: debit. Status Pratinjau: hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS. Hanya rezim subkritis, satu alur per reach. Struktur lateral, storage area, area 2D, sambungan, dan pompa dihitung sejak 0.2.3 (juga Pratinjau); jembatan, gorong-gorong, dan struktur inline belum dihitung di unsteady.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Pick the reach and section. Top plot: stage with the channel invert line. Bottom plot: flow. Preview status: results are not compared with HEC-RAS yet. Subcritical only, one flow path per reach. Lateral structures, storage areas, 2D areas, connections and pumps are computed since 0.2.3 (also Preview); bridges, culverts and inline structures are not computed in unsteady runs yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Tabel tanggal, jam, muka air, dan debit di satu penampang setiap waktu keluaran.
short.en: A table of date, hour, stage and flow at one cross section for every output time.

body.id:
Fungsi

Tabel bisa disalin ke spreadsheet. Status Pratinjau: hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS. Hanya rezim subkritis, satu alur per reach. Struktur lateral, storage area, area 2D, sambungan, dan pompa dihitung sejak 0.2.3 (juga Pratinjau); jembatan, gorong-gorong, dan struktur inline belum dihitung di unsteady.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

The table can be copied into a spreadsheet. Preview status: results are not compared with HEC-RAS yet. Subcritical only, one flow path per reach. Lateral structures, storage areas, 2D areas, connections and pumps are computed since 0.2.3 (also Preview); bridges, culverts and inline structures are not computed in unsteady runs yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Pelimpah atau tanggul di sisi reach yang mengalirkan air ke storage area, area 2D, atau keluar sistem.
short.en: A weir or levee along a reach that spills water into a storage area, a 2D area or out of the system.

body.id:
Fungsi

Aliran dihitung dengan persamaan pelimpah Q = C·L·H^1,5 per potongan mercu, dengan reduksi tenggelam Villemonte bila muka air hilir naik. Aliran bisa berbalik bila area lebih tinggi dari sungai. Koefisien default 1,1 (SI) atau 2,0 (US). Struktur lateral hanya dihitung di plan unsteady; plan steady mengabaikannya dengan peringatan.

Langkah

  1. Di Data Geometri, pilih reach, lalu klik Struktur Lateral di palet.
  2. Klik Tambah, isi RS (di antara dua penampang), sisi (kiri atau kanan menghadap hilir), dan jarak dari penampang hulu.
  3. Pilih tujuan: keluar sistem, storage area, atau area 2D.
  4. Isi tabel stasiun–elevasi mercu dan koefisien pelimpah.
  5. Bila perlu, isi data keruntuhan (breach) dan klik Perkiraan Froehlich untuk usulan lebar dan waktu runtuh.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Blok Lateral Weir di file .g## (Type 6). Data breach disimpan di file .deras.json proyek karena HEC-RAS menyimpannya di plan.

Hasil

Hidrograf debit lateral tampil di Hasil (pilih "Struktur lateral: …" di daftar reach). Status Pratinjau: dihitung oleh Analisis Unsteady, hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Flow uses the weir equation Q = C·L·H^1.5 per crest piece, with Villemonte submergence when the tailwater rises. Flow reverses when the area is higher than the river. Default coefficient 1.1 (SI) or 2.0 (US). Lateral structures are computed in unsteady plans only; steady plans skip them with a warning.

Steps

  1. In Geometric Data, select the reach, then click Lateral Structure in the palette.
  2. Click Add, enter the RS (between two cross sections), the side (left or right looking downstream) and the distance from the upstream section.
  3. Pick the destination: out of the system, a storage area or a 2D area.
  4. Fill the crest station–elevation table and the weir coefficient.
  5. If needed, fill the breach data and click Froehlich estimate for a suggested width and formation time.

Data needed

Lateral Weir lines in the .g## file (Type 6). Breach data is stored in the project's .deras.json, because HEC-RAS keeps it in the plan file.

Result

The lateral flow hydrograph appears in Results (pick "Lateral structure: …" in the reach list). Preview status: computed by Unsteady Flow Analysis; results are not compared with HEC-RAS yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Kolam atau dataran yang menampung air dengan satu muka air datar.
short.en: A pond or floodplain that stores water at one level water surface.

body.id:
Fungsi

Volume dari tabel elevasi–volume, dari luas datar di atas elevasi minimum, atau dari terrain di dalam poligon. Muka air semua storage area yang terhubung dihitung bersama dengan Newton di setiap langkah.

Langkah

  1. Klik Storage Area di palet, lalu gambar poligon di kanvas (klik titik-titik, klik ganda untuk selesai), atau klik Tambah di daftar.
  2. Beri nama dan pilih cara menghitung volume.
  3. Isi tabel elevasi–volume atau luas dan elevasi minimum, atau pilih Terrain.
  4. Hubungkan dengan struktur lateral, sambungan SA/2D, atau pompa.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Blok Storage Area di file .g##.

Hasil

Muka air dan volume storage area tampil di Hasil. Status Pratinjau: dihitung oleh Analisis Unsteady, hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Volume comes from an elevation–volume table, from a flat area above a minimum elevation, or from the terrain inside the polygon. The water surfaces of all connected storage areas are solved together with Newton iterations at every step.

Steps

  1. Click Storage Area in the palette, then draw the polygon on the canvas (click the points, double-click to finish), or click Add in the list.
  2. Give it a name and choose how the volume is computed.
  3. Fill the elevation–volume table, or the area and minimum elevation, or choose Terrain.
  4. Connect it with a lateral structure, an SA/2D connection or a pump.

Data needed

Storage Area block in the .g## file.

Result

The storage area stage appears in Results. Preview status: computed by Unsteady Flow Analysis; results are not compared with HEC-RAS yet.

Status: Preview

short.id: Wilayah dataran yang alirannya dihitung 2D di atas grid sel persegi.
short.en: A floodplain region where flow is computed in 2D on a grid of square cells.

body.id:
Fungsi

Metode: persamaan gelombang difusi, implisit penuh, di grid persegi di dalam poligon. Setiap sel menyimpan sampel terrain (subgrid), sehingga volume sel dan konveyansi muka sel mengikuti bentuk terrain di dalam sel. Ini berbeda dari mesh poligon HEC-RAS; hasilnya belum dibandingkan. Area 2D membutuhkan terrain di RAS Mapper.

Langkah

  1. Pastikan terrain sudah ditambahkan di RAS Mapper.
  2. Klik Area 2D di palet, lalu gambar poligon di kanvas.
  3. Isi nama, ukuran sel (kosong = sekitar 1/60 sisi terpanjang), dan n Manning.
  4. Tambahkan BC line di tepi area bila air harus masuk atau keluar lewat tepi itu.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Blok Storage Area dengan Storage Area Is2D=-1 di file .g##; ukuran sel di baris Point Generation Data.

Hasil

Kedalaman maksimum, kedalaman per waktu, kecepatan maksimum, dan waktu tiba tampil di RAS Mapper → Hasil area 2D. Selisih volume ditulis di pesan run. Status Pratinjau: dihitung oleh Analisis Unsteady, hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Method: diffusion-wave equations, fully implicit, on a square grid inside the polygon. Every cell keeps its terrain samples (subgrid), so the cell volume and the face conveyance follow the terrain inside the cell. This differs from the HEC-RAS polygon mesh; results are not compared yet. A 2D area needs a terrain in RAS Mapper.

Steps

  1. Make sure a terrain is added in RAS Mapper.

short.id: Persamaan kapasitas angkut di alur utama.
short.en: The transport capacity equation of the main channel.

body.id:
Fungsi

Meyer-Peter Müller (1948): angkutan dasar untuk pasir kasar dan kerikil, qs* = 8 (θ' − 0,047)^1,5 dengan koreksi kekasaran butir (n'/n)^1,5, n' = d90^(1/6)/26. Engelund-Hansen (1967): muatan total untuk pasir, qs = 0,05 V² √(d/(g(s−1))) θ^1,5. Yang (1973): muatan total pasir dari daya aliran satuan VS; untuk d50 di atas 2 mm hitungan memberi peringatan. Kecepatan endap memakai rumus Soulsby (1997).

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Meyer-Peter Müller (1948): bed load for coarse sand and gravel, qs* = 8 (θ' − 0.047)^1.5 with the grain roughness correction (n'/n)^1.5, n' = d90^(1/6)/26. Engelund-Hansen (1967): total load for sand, qs = 0.05 V² √(d/(g(s−1))) θ^1.5. Yang (1973): total sand load from the unit stream power VS; a warning is given for d50 above 2 mm. Fall velocity uses Soulsby (1997).

body.id:
Fungsi

Di setiap interval hitung: hidraulika steady → kapasitas angkut di setiap penampang → persamaan Exner (1 − p) B L dz/dt = Qs,masuk − Qs,keluar. Bila dasar akan berubah lebih dari 5 % kedalaman air, langkah dibagi otomatis dan hidraulika dihitung ulang. Neraca massa (masuk − keluar = perubahan dasar) ditampilkan di bawah tabel.

  2. Atur interval keluaran (jam).
  3. Klik Hitung sedimen.

body.en:

When the bed would change by more than 5 % of the water depth, the step is split automatically and the hydraulics are recomputed. The mass balance (in − out = bed change) is shown below the table.

Steps

short.id: Debit dari kedalaman, atau kedalaman normal dari debit, di saluran trapesium (persamaan Manning).
short.en: Flow from depth, or normal depth from flow, in a trapezoidal channel (Manning's equation).

body.id:
Fungsi

Q = (k/n) A R^(2/3) S^(1/2), k = 1 (SI) atau 1,486 (US). Kedalaman normal dicari dengan metode bagi dua. Kedalaman kritis dari Q²T/(gA³) = 1. Tegangan geser dasar τ = γRS. Talud z = 0 berarti saluran persegi.

Langkah

  1. Isi lebar dasar, talud, n dan kemiringan.
  2. Pilih Debit dari kedalaman atau Kedalaman normal dari debit.
  3. Isi kedalaman atau debit; hasil dan gambar penampang langsung diperbarui.

body.en:
Purpose

Steps

  1. Enter the bottom width, side slope, n and slope.
  2. Choose Flow from depth or Normal depth from flow.
  3. Enter the depth or flow; the results and the cross-section drawing update at once.

short.id: Gerusan pilar, gerusan kontraksi dan gerusan abutmen menurut FHWA HEC-18 edisi ke-5 (2012).
short.en: Pier, contraction and abutment scour after FHWA HEC-18, 5th edition (2012).

body.id:
Fungsi

Pilar (persamaan CSU): ys/a = 2,0 K1 K2 K3 (y1/a)^0,35 Fr1^0,43; K1 dari bentuk ujung (persegi 1,1; bulat dan silinder 1,0; runcing 0,9; K1 = 1 bila sudut serang > 5°), K2 = (cos θ + L/a sin θ)^0,65 dengan L/a paling besar 12, K3 dari kondisi dasar. Untuk pilar ujung bulat yang searah aliran, batas atas 2,4a untuk Fr ≤ 0,8 dan 3,0a di atasnya. Kontraksi dasar hidup (Laursen 1960 termodifikasi): y2/y1 = (Q2/Q1)^(6/7) (W1/W2)^k1, k1 0,59/0,64/0,69 dari V*/ω. Kontraksi air jernih (Laursen 1963): y2 = [Ku Q² / (Dm^(2/3) W²)]^(3/7), Dm = 1,25 D50. Gerusan = y2 − y0. Abutmen (Froehlich 1989): ys/ya = 2,27 K1 K2 (L'/ya)^0,43 Fr^0,61 + 1.

Langkah

  1. Pilih plan, profil dan penampang di Ambil nilai dari hasil hitungan, lalu klik Isi dari hasil (atau isi manual).
  2. Lengkapi data pilar, kontraksi dan abutmen.
  3. Baca gerusan di bawah setiap kartu dan total di pilar di bagian bawah.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Isi dari hasil memakai y1 = kedalaman maksimum alur utama, V1 = kecepatan alur utama, Q1 = debit alur, Q2 = debit total, S1 = kemiringan energi, Ve = debit/luas bantaran kiri. Nilai ini titik awal; periksa terhadap kondisi jembatan sebenarnya.

Hasil

Status Pratinjau: rumus dan hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS. Keputusan desain tetap tanggung jawab perencana.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

Pier (CSU equation): ys/a = 2.0 K1 K2 K3 (y1/a)^0.35 Fr1^0.43; K1 from the nose shape (square 1.1; round and circular 1.0; sharp 0.9; K1 = 1 when the attack angle is above 5°), K2 = (cos θ + L/a sin θ)^0.65 with L/a at most 12, K3 from the bed condition. For round-nose piers aligned with the flow, the upper limit is 2.4a for Fr ≤ 0.8 and 3.0a above. Live-bed contraction (modified Laursen 1960): y2/y1 = (Q2/Q1)^(6/7) (W1/W2)^k1, k1 0.59/0.64/0.69 from V*/ω. Clear-water contraction (Laursen 1963): y2 = [Ku Q² / (Dm^(2/3) W²)]^(3/7), Dm = 1.25 D50. Scour = y2 − y0. Abutment (Froehlich 1989): ys/ya = 2.27 K1 K2 (L'/ya)^0.43 Fr^0.61 + 1.

Steps

  1. Choose the plan, profile and cross section under Take values from computed results, then click Fill from results (or enter values by hand).
  2. Complete the pier, contraction and abutment data.
  3. Read the scour below each card and the total at the pier at the bottom.

Data needed

Fill from results uses y1 = maximum main-channel depth, V1 = main-channel velocity, Q1 = channel flow, Q2 = total flow, S1 = energy slope, Ve = left overbank flow/area. These are starting values; check them against the actual bridge.

Result

Status: Preview

short.id: Mencari satu faktor pengali n Manning agar muka air hitungan steady paling dekat dengan muka air terukur.
short.en: Finds one factor on Manning's n so that the steady water surfaces come closest to the observed ones.

body.id:
Fungsi

De-RAS menjalankan hitungan steady berulang (pencarian golden-section pada log faktor di rentang yang diisi) dan meminimalkan RMS selisih muka air di penampang yang punya pengamatan. Faktor dipakai pada n alur utama saja atau pada semua n. Satu faktor untuk seluruh geometri; variasi n per lokasi belum dikalibrasi.

Langkah

  1. Pilih plan steady dan profil yang sesuai dengan kejadian terukur.
  2. Isi muka air terukur di kolom terakhir.
  3. Klik Kalibrasi dan periksa grafik serta RMS.
  4. Klik Terapkan ke geometri bila hasilnya masuk akal, simpan, lalu hitung ulang.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Pengamatan disimpan di .deras.json (modul calibration). Terapkan ke geometri mengalikan n di file geometri plan; perubahan bisa dibatalkan dengan menutup tanpa menyimpan.

Hasil

Status Pratinjau: rumus dan hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS. Keputusan desain tetap tanggung jawab perencana.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

De-RAS runs the steady computation repeatedly (golden-section search on the log of the factor within the given range) and minimises the RMS water-surface difference at the sections with observations. The factor applies to the main-channel n only or to every n. One factor for the whole geometry; n by location is not calibrated yet.

Steps

  1. Choose the steady plan and the profile that matches the observed event.
  2. Enter the observed water surfaces in the last column.
  3. Click Calibrate and check the plot and the RMS.
  4. Click Apply to geometry if the result makes sense, save, then compute again.

Data needed

Observations are stored in .deras.json (calibration module). Apply to geometry multiplies the n values in the plan's geometry file; close without saving to undo.

Result

short.en: Constituent, initial concentration, dispersion coefficient, decay rate and upstream inflow concentration.

body.id:
Fungsi

Kualitas air memakai hidraulika (muka air dan debit setiap waktu keluaran) dari hasil unsteady plan yang dipilih, di reach pertama plan itu. Satu konstituen dalam mg/L dengan peluruhan orde-1 (laju per hari, 0 = konservatif). Suhu, DO dan nutrien belum tersedia.

Langkah

  1. Pilih plan unsteady yang sudah dihitung.
  2. Isi nama konstituen, konsentrasi awal, dispersi dan laju peluruhan.
  3. Isi tabel jam dan konsentrasi di hulu.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Disimpan di .deras.json (modul water_quality). File .w## HEC-RAS belum dibaca atau ditulis.

Hasil

Status Pratinjau: rumus dan hasil belum dibandingkan dengan HEC-RAS. Keputusan desain tetap tanggung jawab perencana.

body.en:
Purpose

Water quality uses the hydraulics (water surface and flow at every output time) of the stored unsteady results of the chosen plan, in that plan's first reach. One constituent in mg/L with first-order decay (rate per day, 0 = conservative). Temperature, DO and nutrients are not available yet.

Steps

  1. Choose an unsteady plan that has been computed.
  2. Enter the constituent name, initial concentration, dispersion and decay rate.
  3. Fill the table of hours and upstream concentration.

Data needed

Stored in .deras.json (water_quality module). HEC-RAS .w## files are not read or written yet.

Result

Preview status: equations and results are not compared with HEC-RAS yet. Design decisions remain the engineer's responsibility.

short.id: Menghitung sebaran konsentrasi sepanjang reach terhadap waktu.
short.en: Computes the concentration along the reach over time.

body.id:
Fungsi

Persamaan adveksi-dispersi 1D dengan volume hingga implisit (adveksi upwind, dispersi beda tengah), langkah dibagi agar bilangan Courant sekitar 1. Neraca massa: perubahan simpanan = masuk − keluar − meluruh + koreksi kontinuitas hidraulik. Koreksi muncul karena hidraulika yang tersimpan per waktu keluaran tidak menutup kontinuitas persis; nilainya ditampilkan agar terlihat besarnya (biasanya jauh di bawah 1 % massa masuk).

Langkah

  1. Isi Data Kualitas Air.
  2. Klik Hitung kualitas air.
  3. Geser slider waktu; grafik kanan menunjukkan konsentrasi di hulu, tengah dan hilir; Ekspor CSV untuk semua waktu.

Data yang dibutuhkan

Hasil ditulis ke <nama>.<plan>.deras-wq.json. Contoh: proyek DerasUji1km memakai pelacak 100 mg/L selama 3 jam pada banjir p02.

Status: Pratinjau
body.en:
Purpose

1D advection-dispersion with an implicit finite volume scheme (upwind advection, central dispersion); steps are split so that the Courant number is about 1. Mass balance: change in storage = in − out − decayed + hydraulic continuity correction. The correction appears because the stored hydraulics at output times do not close continuity exactly; it is shown so its size is visible (usually far below 1 % of the mass in).

Steps

  1. Fill the Water Quality Data.
  2. Click Compute water quality.
  3. Move the time slider; the right plot shows the concentration upstream, in the middle and downstream; Export CSV for all times.

Data needed

Results go to <name>.<plan>.deras-wq.json. Example: the DerasUji1km project uses a 100 mg/L tracer for 3 hours on the p02 flood.

Status: Preview
